name: remove execute permission while leaving files in place and unrun
definition: Strip execute bits from both the original and cleaned scripts and leave the original at its path; the analysis must not execute either script.
failure_mode: A script is run directly or kept executable, leaving side effects or failing the permission checks.

name: replicate reference cross-entropy loss scaling and microbatched gradient accumulation
definition: Compute the loss on the final stage scaled by the number of microbatches and accumulate gradients so the summed result matches a reference that averages over microbatches.
failure_mode: Incorrect loss scaling or accumulation yields divergent gradients

name: resolve the sections of interest and the symbol-string tables
definition: Identify text/data/read-only sections and their string tables, resolving null-terminated names from the string sections.
failure_mode: Missing or misindexed sections drop most expected addresses.

name: restore execute and read permissions on shell scripts
definition: Set the file-mode bits so the scripts can be read and executed by the user.
failure_mode: Missing execute/read bits fail the stat checks.
